text.tspan: Your hips are moving toward the ball
through impact. That’s early extension,
and I’m sure of it.

your hips have moved toward the ball.

One drill and one mobility exercise. Nothing else this bucket.

text.tspan: Backside against a wall or golf bag.
Slow half swings; keep your trail
glute on the wall through impact.
Sit with both knees at 90°. Rotate
slowly side to side, chest tall.
Generic guidance, not medical advice —
see a physiotherapist if you feel pain.

svg.text: 2 other faults in my rule table
Posture angle changed 6°, below the 9° fault line. No drill.
Capped at medium: measured from hand path only.

text.tspan: Why does it feel like I’m staying down
when I’m not?
The move happens below your eye line, so you don’t feel it.
Your hips moved 7% of body height[3] toward the ball. In the
impact frame[2] you can see the gap to the dashed line. In the
wall drill, a glute leaving the wall is the same move.
